prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1445; do not mention it.)
text: I was stopped at a red light on the main road in Baytown, Texas, waiting for the traffic ahead to clear, when I felt a hard impact from behind. The vehicle behind me did not appear to slow down before striking my rear bumper. My car was pushed forward into the intersection and my head snapped back against the headrest. I got out and spoke with the other driver, who said they had looked down at their phone for a moment. Both vehicles were drivable but had visible damage to the rear and front ends. I was taken by ambulance to the nearest emergency room, where X-rays showed a fracture in my left wrist. I was put in a cast and told to follow up with an orthopedic specialist. I have photos of the scene and both vehicles, and I am providing the police report number on the attached sheet.
